targets.name: Stone niche owl
targets.concealment: The owl shares the pale weathered stone of its recess, framed by ferns and flowing water.

targets.name: Frog on the mossy terrace
targets.concealment: The mottled stone frog shares the gray and moss-green textures of the wet terrace, with its bent limbs partly merging into nearby roots and rock edges.

targets.name: Shelf ammonite
targets.concealment: The warm fossil ridges blend with carved stone, wicker and matching old book edges.

targets.name: Gold fern cabinet inlay
targets.concealment: The thin fern motif is part of the same gold-on-brown cabinet decoration as many neighboring leaves.

targets.name: Key on the book cart
targets.concealment: The narrow brass key is aligned with tall book spines and partly screened by hanging fabric.

targets.name: Brass cart hare
targets.concealment: The brown-gold hare is recessed inside the cart end, sharing timber color and curved handles.

targets.name: Bronze fox bookend
targets.concealment: The bronze fox shares the worn brown color and fine texture of nearby leather bindings; ivy and a book overlap its left tail edge.

targets.name: Stone frog bookend
targets.concealment: The squat brown shape is nested against stacked books, mottled pottery and foliage.

targets.name: Carved stone leaf mask
targets.concealment: A small leaf-like stone face is incorporated into a bookcase pier and shares its weathering.

targets.name: Small brass pocket watch
targets.concealment: The small antique brass case and cream dial are nestled between similar gold-embossed book spines and the cart rail; the hanging loop merges into the background binding.

targets.name: Small shelf armillary
targets.concealment: The fine gold rings overlap stems and book decoration in the middle-distance shelving.

targets.name: Large brass globe
targets.concealment: The large globe is distinct above the nearest book cart.

targets.name: Hanging brass birdcage
targets.concealment: The broad cage hangs openly against pale stone.

targets.name: Brass tripod telescope
targets.concealment: The long gold telescope stands clearly on its tripod.

targets.name: Rail-top lantern
targets.concealment: The large lantern occupies a clear foreground railing corner.
